_readme: creandum.com/portfolio (the 2017-2023 static site) read from one Wayback snapshot per year (2017, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023; first capture of the year, raw id_ replay) on 2026-09-04: every cr-portfolio__item's data attributes — the sprite id (slug), data-invested (the firm's own investment year), data-partner, data-status (active/inactive at that snapshot; the latest wins), data-type (consumer/enterprise), data-founded, data-ceo, data-url — unioned by slug with the years each company was listed. No name element exists on that page: names come from the logo sprite's <title> where the sprite carried one, else from the slug. Regenerated by the PRO-72 scratch script portfolio-2017-2023.py (copied into scratch/). Sprite ids that are not names (kry_logo2, tide_black, knl-2, ipt, ...) are mapped to the company's name in scratch/portfolio-2017-2023.py's NAME_OVERRIDES / this post-pass; the live CMS rendering wins at build where the company is still listed.
